tourGenerateDescription: Describe the scene, models, character motion, and camera requirements, then click “Generate plan.” You can reference linked text, image, and video nodes on the canvas with @.
tourPlansDescription: Generated plans appear here. Click a plan to preview its animation from the beginning and view its input prompt, or enter new requirements to generate another plan. Plans share the same base scene and models.
tourFramingDescription: Click the 3D view and use the mouse to aim. Use WASD to move, Space to rise, Shift to descend, and the wheel to zoom. Left-click or press Esc to exit framing.
tourKeyframesDescription: Right-click while framing, or click “Add keyframe,” to record the current shot. Drag keyframes to reorder them, click to review, or delete them. When you generate another plan, AI uses these shots and their order to design the camera movement. Use the export button to create an image node from a keyframe.
tourPlaybackDescription: Review the animation with the play button and timeline. Adjust the aspect ratio, grid, sky, and lighting here to refine the preview.
tourExportDescription: Select a plan, then export it as a video node. The export button on a keyframe thumbnail creates an image node. Keep this window visible during video export, then return to the canvas when it finishes.
mp4Unsupported: This browser cannot export MP4. Update your browser or desktop WebView2 runtime
